title: The Quay Robbery
premise: Under cover of darkness, a raider emptied the clerk's payroll chest. Ivo has cornered him and his two mechanical guards in Lantern Garden.
briefing:
Ivo: "There he is. The payroll pouch is on his belt."

Tessa Ward: "Give us the money. You have nowhere to go."

Crimson Raider: "Then you should have stayed outside. Guards!"
objective: Defeat the raider and his guards. Take back the stolen payroll.
discovery: The raider has surrendered. Search him for the payroll pouch.
resolution:
Ivo: "I'll hold him here. Take the payroll back to the clerk."

Mara: "Let's get everyone paid."
records: A visitor's history of Lantern Quay: the old timber piers, the rebuilding of the tower, and the public garden planted above the eastern sea wall.
map_note: Lantern Garden is a walled terrace reached through the east gate.

opening.speaker: Mara
opening.text: The tower's gone out. I was waiting for my pay to buy more oil.

opening.speaker: Mara
opening.text: Did you hear that? Glass breaking, over at the clerk's office.

opening.speaker: Tessa Ward
opening.text: I'll check on her. Stay here.

ending.speaker: Mara
ending.text: There's enough oil now to keep the tower burning till morning.

ending.speaker: Mara
ending.text: I can see every plank again. Thank you for coming back with me.

ending_early.speaker: Mara
ending_early.text: Your oil kept the tower burning while we were gone. I've bought enough for the rest of the night.

ending_early.speaker: Mara
ending_early.text: I can see every plank again. Thank you for coming back with me.

surrender: Crimson Raider: "I surrender! Take the payroll pouch. Just call them off."
